items.title: US stocks jump as employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs, raising hopes for easier rate policy
items.summary: Stocks rose on Wall Street Friday and Treasury yields fell after the government reported that employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs last month.  Technology stocks, with their big market values, did much of the heavy lifting for the broader market.  The bond market reacted more strongly to the weaker signal on the job market, which can be seen as allowing the Federal Reserve more time before raising interest rates to fight inflation.
